visual.name: zentrixOrgChart
visual.description: Draw any parent-child hierarchy as a tree of cards — org charts, chart of accounts, product hierarchies, bills of materials, legal entities. Any root shape works (blank, missing, self-referencing), cycles can never hang it, and collapsed branches stay collapsed. Free: both orientations, photo cards, search, cross-filtering and full styling. Pro adds export, dotted-line reporting, org analytics, conditional-formatting rules, period comparison and annotations.
